title: T-032 FTS5 shadow index
summary: A separate FTS5 shadow artifact was built for all 26,559 canonical chunks without modifying the canonical database or live retrieval path.
evidence: The artifact contains 26,559 search documents and 1,185 sources keyed by canonical chunk ID.
Thirteen focused tests passed, including schema, indexing, ranking, bridge compatibility, failure, and idempotent rebuild cases.
The builder, focused test, report, and isolated shadow artifact are the only additions.
The canonical staging database checksum remained unchanged and the worktree has no remote.
The existing lexical path remains the fallback when the shadow artifact is absent or invalid.
Rollback requires removing the separate artifact and clearing its configuration path.
limitations: The artifact is isolated staging output and is not configured in production.
